s.how: Drain a tin of chopped clams, keeping a little juice. Fold into 200g cream cheese and 100g sour cream with lemon juice, a dash of Worcestershire and chives. Serve with a bag of potato chips.

Drain a tin of water chestnuts and wrap each in half a rasher of bacon, about 8 rashers in total. Brush with 2 tbsp soy, 2 tbsp brown sugar and grated ginger. Bake at 200C for 20 minutes until sticky.

m.how: Boil 600g new potatoes for 10 minutes in a big pot. Add 4 halved corn cobs, 250ml white wine, 3 garlic cloves and 80g butter, then 1kg clams and 4 lobster tails. Cover and steam 8 minutes. Tip it all onto the table.

w.how: Melt 60g butter with 80g brown sugar in a tin. Lay pineapple rings with a cherry in each. Beat 125g butter and 125g sugar, add 2 eggs and fold in 175g self-raising flour. Spread over and bake at 175C for 45 minutes. Flip out.

d.how: For each drink, shake 30ml white rum, 30ml dark rum, 15ml orange liqueur, 15ml orgeat and 25ml lime juice with ice. Strain over crushed ice and top with a mint sprig. Makes four.
